artifact.title: Business is NEAR Prototype Website Draft
artifact.summary: This document outlines a draft for a concise, one-page website introducing the 'Business is NEAR' prototype. The website content is tailored for founders and focuses on explaining what the prototype is: an AI team for founders where owners approve tasks and limits on NEAR. It explicitly mentions that this demonstration uses a public NEAR testnet and local Gemma, while clarifying that NEAR AI Cloud, TEE execution, and mainnet are unverified. The draft is intended for owner review.

items.text: Introduction to Business is NEAR: A working prototype of an AI team designed specifically for founders.
Core Functionality: Founders maintain control by approving tasks and setting limits on NEAR usage.
Technical Context: This synthetic demonstration utilizes the public NEAR testnet and local Gemma models.
Important Disclaimer: NEAR AI Cloud, TEE execution, and mainnet status remain unverified. A draft requires owner review.

receipts.label: Owner approves the website and limits
